what_was_done: Liveness of a held running record is now judged by the product's process group, as stop_products signals it: a new _group_alive helper beside _pid_alive in jobs.py answers killpg(pid, 0) - ProcessLookupError means the group is gone, PermissionError means live. It is used in _held_answer's running branch and in _wait_for_running, so only a record whose group is gone, under a held lock, counts as a start in flight; a product whose leader died while its group holds the inherited lock is answered at the same commit and its group stopped and replaced at another one, instead of every start failing 'still settling' after 5 s. _wait_for_running probes the product lock on each poll and returns None when it comes free, so a holder that dies without writing no longer costs the waiting start the full _STARTING_WAIT - the caller takes the lock and starts. The four C1-2 tests still pass. New tests in test_env.py cover the held-state cases: test_start_joins_a_start_call_still_in_flight (a live start call's record is waited for and answered, case 1), test_start_answers_when_the_leaders_group_still_holds_the_lock (run='sleep 30 & wait', leader SIGKILLed: the start at the same commit answers at once with exit 0 - both fail against the pre-fix pid-liveness code, exit 1 after 5 s), test_start_replaces_a_leaders_surviving_group_at_another_commit (the surviving group is killpg-stopped and a new product started; fails pre-fix), test_start_clears_a_stale_record_with_nothing_alive (a stale record behind no holder at the head commit and at another; a regression guard, case 4) and test_start_takes_the_lock_when_a_holder_exits_without_writing (a stale running record under a holder that exits after 0.8 s without writing: the start returns 0 in well under _STARTING_WAIT at the head commit and at another; fails against the code without the lock probe). commands/env-start.md now says the lock is judged by the product's process group and that the waiting call takes a freed lock. All five new tests pass against the fix; the leader-pair and holder tests fail against the respective mutants.
